disease_label_per_paper: Acute myelomonocytic leukemia (FAB M4) presenting with adult-onset Still's disease-like symptoms
presentation_summary: 23-year-old woman presented with 2 months of symmetric polyarthritis, daily fever, sore throat history, weight loss, and later salmon-colored rash during fever spikes.
Vitals and exam included heart rate 117/min, respiratory rate 17/min, blood pressure 100/70 mmHg, pallor, joint swelling/tenderness, and daily fever peaks reaching 40 C.
Presentation labs showed pancytopenia with WBC 2.9 x10^9/L, hemoglobin 6.5 g/dL, platelets 100 x10^9/L, ESR 98 mm/h, CRP 34 mg/dL, albumin 2.8 g/dL, ferritin 5000 ng/mL, and LDH 322 U/L.
Blood cultures and viral/rheumatologic tests were negative; CT chest/abdomen/pelvis did not show malignancy. Bone marrow and immunophenotyping later established AML.
